[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 0
- Description: Live-progress introspection UAT (U1-U5) + #467 raw-text classifier fix
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/467
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1206
  
  Details:
  Ran the operator acceptance tests (U1-U5) for SOPHIA_LIVE_PROGRESS_PLAN against the deployed autopilot build, diagnosed and fixed a residual PR2 classifier defect, and closed out the plan.
  
  Scope of work:
  - Re-verified deploy state after repeated deploy-caused turn restarts (HEAD, services, /health, fix presence in deployed adapter).
  - Ran U1-U5 on the live brain, using the in-flight turn itself as the "busy turn":
    - U1 busy-ack carries live snapshot
    - U2 "progress?" during a busy turn -> immediate templated snapshot, not queued
    - U3 real instruction during a busy turn -> still queued
    - U4 progress query, nothing running -> graceful "nothing running right now"
    - U5 introspection ~70ms, never blocks the executing turn
  - Diagnosed U2 failure: PR2 status classifier was fed the decorated dispatch_text (handoff prefix ~479 chars + "[Telegram context: ...]"), always exceeding _is_progress_query's 80-char cap, so status pings never classified in handoff-registered topics.
  - Opened fix PR #467 (classify on raw user text instead of decorated text) + 2 regression tests with a negative control proving they fail fast on unpatched code; validated the full local suite (compileall/ruff/format/pytest).
  - After human merge + deploy (HEAD 1254da2), re-ran U2/U3/U4 end-to-end on deployed code, including a cross-process live GET /chat/progress returning {"running": true, "snapshot": ...} while the turn held the lock.
  - Closed out the plan: PR #1206 to agentic_ai_context completing the resume tracker and clearing the RESUME HERE markers.
  
  Outcome: U1-U5 all pass on the deployed build; plan complete.
  
  Verification:
  - Deploy live: HEAD 1254da2, both services active, /health 200, fix present (app/telegram_adapter.py lines 2193 + 2214).
  - Deployed regression tests: pytest -k progress_gate -> 2 passed.
  - Cross-process GET /chat/progress against own in-flight turn -> 200 {"running": true, "snapshot": ...}.
  
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 0.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
